name: PP-DocLayoutV3
paper_title: RT-DocLayout: Real-Time End-to-End Document Layout Analysis with Reading Order in the Wild
license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license, so the PP-DocLayoutV3 weights and LibreYOLO's port can be used in commercial and closed-source products. Redistributing them means keeping the license text and attribution notices, and the license grants a patent license. LibreYOLO's network is an inference-only PyTorch port of the Apache-2.0 reference in Hugging Face Transformers (v5.22.1, commit 446a570e62b04a89ea001604ada7366baac2ea67, Copyright The PaddlePaddle Team and The HuggingFace Inc. team) and needs no transformers runtime (libreyolo/models/ppdoclayoutv3/NOTICE). The checkpoint is converted from PaddlePaddle/PP-DocLayoutV3_safetensors at revision e4f489dc536556fc1be02b973ba06756e0d4a2ac, declared Apache-2.0 by its model card; that repository ships no LICENSE file, so the mirror at LibreYOLO/LibrePPDocLayoutV3l carries the Apache-2.0 text of the PaddleOCR project. Conversion only strips a key prefix and adds metadata; learned parameters are unchanged, and the mirror is not gated.
